messages:
Sam (Support): escalating to CS P1. Nimbus trial activation failing: embed provisioning returns 502s, blocks demo. Customer asked for urgent help or refund.
Ava (CS): ack. How wide is impact and when last success?
Sam (Support): only trial account affected, seats not activating. Last success 2024-11-15T14:12Z. Logs show repeated `upstream_status=502` and `req_6b2c`. Tried restart worker pool, clear cache, swap region -> no change. Ticket NT-9123.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2024-591 created (P1). Pager alerted.
Diego (CS Lead): Owners: Ava = CS lead, Sam = support triage, Kai = SE. Create comms plan and hourly updates.
Kai (Solutions Eng): quick find: route fallback timing out under repeated 502s causing cascades. Mitigation: extend fallback timeout to 8s + aggressive retry for Nimbus id. Will push to staging for smoke.
Ava (CS): Draft comms: 1) Ack within 30m (Sam) 2) hourly internal updates here 3) exec note if >3h 4) postmortem + credits if >2h downtime. Sam send ack and include NT-9123 link.
Sam (Support): Ack sent at 15:18 UTC. Staging smoke started.
Kai (Solutions Eng): Staging smoke passed. Canary 5% started 15:53 UTC. Errors sampled down ~95%.
Diego (CS Lead): Increase to 50% for 10m then full if stable.
Kai (Solutions Eng): 50% stable -> promoting to full. Monitoring.
oncall-bot: INC-2024-591 status -> mitigated.
Ava (CS): Sending customer update: apology, what were doing, ETA, contacts (ava@redwood.ai, kai@redwood.ai). Scheduling enablement session next week.
Sam (Support): Customer says improvement, will re-run demo checks. Please confirm when fully resolved.
Diego (CS Lead): Actions: Kai -> postmortem + RCA (24h draft), Sam -> collect full logs, Ava -> renewal guardrail note + schedule enablement, Diego -> coordinate credits if >2h.
Ava (CS): Updating renewal tracker and will close handback after postmortem posted. Thanks team.
